title: Smart Budgets Launch Go/No-Go
summary: The team reviewed the upcoming Smart Budgets launch and identified a critical bank‑sync duplication bug affecting about 8% of accounts. The launch was postponed from October 15 to October 29 to allow Aisha to implement a deduplication fix and backfill data. Email‑only weekly summary notifications were approved for the launch, with Jordan owning the email implementation, and Plaid pricing was confirmed at $0.30 per account. The meeting concluded with a conditional go‑ahead for October 29, pending the fix delivery.
